propositions: Project-owned code-review criteria are not dynamically fanned into Pass 1 discovery despite being describable in routing.
Eval and CLI resolution for project code-review criteria are plan-review-biased and do not integrate with the code-review solver.
Pass 3 deterministic disposition does not consistently apply repository-effective threshold, posture, and nit-suppression values from routing.
The code-review extension seam lacks complete integration to support LLM-backed project criteria across all four review phases.
Logical project criterion identifiers must map to physical validator-safe identifiers at prompt and eval dispatch without special-casing the review-phase-boundaries criterion.
